abortion_rule: Abortion should be legal for any reason at any point in pregnancy.
Abortion should be legal for any reason until about 24 weeks; after that, only when the woman's health is at serious risk.
Abortion should be legal for any reason in about the first 12 to 15 weeks; after that, only in specific circumstances.
Abortion should be legal only in specific circumstances, such as rape, incest, or a threat to the woman's life or health.
Abortion should be legal only to save the woman's life.
Abortion should never be legal, even to save the woman's life.
abortion_exceptions: Abortion should be legal in this case, at any point in pregnancy: {case}.
Abortion should not be legal in this case: {case}.
abortion_who_decides: Congress should set one abortion law for the whole country.
Congress should set the main abortion rules, with room for states to adjust details.
Each state should set its own abortion law, as now.
abortion_pills_mail: Doctors should be able to mail abortion pills after an online visit to patients anywhere, including states where abortion is banned.
Doctors can mail abortion pills after an online visit, but only to patients in states where abortion is legal.
Abortion pills should require an in-person visit with a doctor.
Abortion pills should not be available at all.
abortion_shield_laws: A state should be able to fully shield its doctors from other states' prosecution and lawsuits for mailing abortion pills there.
A state can shield its doctors only for care given in person in that state, not pills mailed elsewhere.
Doctors who send abortion pills into a state should face that state's laws.
abortion_public_funding: Programs like Medicaid should pay for legal abortions like any other medical care.
Medicaid should pay for abortions only in cases of rape, incest or a threat to the woman's life, as now.
Government health programs should never pay for abortions.
ivf_embryos: IVF should be legal, and insurance should have to cover it.
IVF should be legal under today's rules.
IVF should be legal, but with limits so unused embryos aren't destroyed.
IVF should be banned because it destroys embryos.
contraception_access: Birth control should be free to anyone, with no prescription needed.
Insurance should have to cover birth control at no extra cost, as now.
Birth control should be legal, but employers and insurers shouldn't have to cover it.
Some kinds of birth control, like emergency contraception, should be restricted.
minors_abortion_parents: A girl under 18 should decide about an abortion with her doctor, without involving her parents.
A parent should be told before a minor's abortion, but their permission shouldn't be required.
A minor should need a parent's permission for an abortion, unless a judge grants an exception.
A minor should always need a parent's permission for an abortion, with no exceptions.
life_begins: A developing human has the same right to life as anyone else only once it's born.
A developing human has an equal right to life once it could survive outside the womb, around 22 to 24 weeks.
A developing human has an equal right to life once cardiac activity can be detected, about 6 weeks.
A developing human has an equal right to life from conception.
surrogacy: Paid surrogacy should be legal and regulated.
Surrogacy should be legal only if unpaid, with the surrogate's expenses covered.
